questions.question: Which benchmark test was proposed to evaluate whether a machine can exhibit human-equivalent intelligence through conversation?
What is the primary objective of a rational agent in Artificial Intelligence?
options: A. To duplicate human decision-making in every scenario.
B. To select actions that maximize its expected performance measure based on its percept sequence.
C. To always make perfect decisions with zero risk of error.
D. To follow a static set of pre-programmed rules.
questions.answer: B. To select actions that maximize its expected performance measure based on its percept sequence.

questions.question: An environment is considered 'fully observable' if:
options: A. The agent has incomplete information about the current state.
B. The environment state changes continuously while the agent deliberates.
C. An agent's sensors give access to the complete state of the environment at each point in time.
D. Multiple agents are operating simultaneously.
questions.answer: C. An agent's sensors give access to the complete state of the environment at each point in time.

questions.question: Which agent structure maintains an internal state to handle partially observable environments?
Which of the following search strategies is classified as an uninformed (blind) search?
A heuristic function h(n) is considered 'admissible' if:
options: A. It overestimates the actual cost to reach the goal state.
B. It never overestimates the cost to reach the goal state.
C. It always equals zero for all generated nodes.
D. It prioritizes nodes with higher path costs.
questions.answer: B. It never overestimates the cost to reach the goal state.

questions.question: Which local search algorithm continuously moves in the direction of increasing value (steepest ascent) but risk getting stuck in local maxima?
Simulated annealing is a search algorithm inspired by which physical process?
options: A. Biological evolution and natural selection
B. The cooling and crystallization of molten metal
C. Gravitational pull in fluid dynamics
questions.answer: B. The cooling and crystallization of molten metal
